# Castel

> > Industrial refrigeration and HVAC component manufacturer specializing in valves, regulators, and safety devices for HCFC, HFC, HFO, HC, and CO2 refrigerants.

Castel produces professional-grade refrigeration components across multiple product lines including Classic, Polyhedra, and Go Green. The company's catalog focuses on expansion valves, solenoid valves, pressure regulators, and protection devices compliant with ASHRAE standards for modern refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.

## Key Topics

- HFC refrigerants (R404A, R407C, R410A, R507, R448A)
- HFO refrigerants
- HCFC refrigerants
- HC (hydrocarbon) refrigerants
- CO2 refrigerant systems
- ASHRAE STANDARD 34-2019 compliance
- Polyhedra product line
- Classic product line
- Go Green product line
- Solenoid valves
- Expansion valves
- Evaporating pressure regulators
- Safety devices and protection systems
- A1 refrigerants
- HVAC components

## Product Catalog Overview

- [Produits - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/types-de-produits): Product catalog: expansion valves, solenoid valves, safety devices

## Solenoid Valves

- [VALVOLE SOLENOIDI - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/linea_descrizione/valvole-solenoidi-00512): Solenoid valves for HCFC, HFC, HFO & HC refrigerants
- [VALVOLE SOLENOIDI NORMALMENTE CHIUSE - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/linea/valvole-solenoidi-normalmente-chiuse-00951): Normally closed solenoid valves for R22, R134a, R404A refrigerants

## Product Lines

- [CLASSIC - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/linea/classic-00514): Classic line: expansion valves, solenoid valves for HCFC/HFC/HFO
- [POLYHEDRA - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/linea/polyhedra-01197): Polyhedra product line: ball valves, screw valves for HVAC systems

## Pressure Regulators and Control Valves

- [REGOLATORI DELLA PRESSIONE DI EVAPORAZIONE, LINEA CLASSIC - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/prodotti/classic-01030/regolatori-della-pressione-di-evaporazione-linea-classic-00818): Classic line evaporating pressure regulators for R22 & A1 refrigerants
- [CHECK VALVES - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/ru/product-line-description/check-valves-00511): One-way check valves for refrigeration systems (Go Green, Polyhedra)

## Safety and Protection Devices

- [DISPOSITIVOS DE PROTECCIÓN - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/lineas-de-productos-descripcion/dispositivos-de-proteccion-00515): Protection devices: filter dryers, level indicators for refrigeration
- [Refrigerating systems protectors - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/product-line-description/refrigerating-systems-protectors-00515): System protectors: filter dryers, mechanical filters for HCFC/HFC/HFO
- [Valvole di sicurezza, linea POLYHEDRA - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/prodotti/polyhedra-01194/valvole-di-sicurezza-linea-polyhedra-01015): Polyhedra safety valves for R134A, R32 & ASHRAE-compliant refrigerants

## Optional

- [VIBRATION ABSORBERS - Castel](https://castel.it/catalog/ru/product-line-description/vibration-absorbers-00513): TIG-welded vibration absorbers for compressors & HVAC systems
